issues.problem: Story said Cao Gui stopped the duke from 'charging' at Qi's first drum; in 左传 the duke was about to drum the attack (公将鼓之).
issues.action: Reworded: stopped him from sounding the attack; Lu drummed only after Qi had drummed three times.

issues.problem: Story's closing line ('her family was already courted enough') read more into 后汉书 than it says.
issues.action: Toned down to: her family was already grand enough and she refused to add honours.

issues.problem: Contexts about mountain weather, the market and 'however the situation shifts' fit 瞬息万变 (cy485, same set) as well or better; near entry 日新月异 was a weaker confusion than 瞬息万变.
issues.action: Replaced the three contexts with ones about countless forms (Monkey King's transformations, calligraphy dialogue, Go); replaced near 日新月异 with 瞬息万变 and its difference.

issues.problem: Context '病人情况千钧一发，医生决定马上手术' is an urgent-but-not-split-second case where 迫在眉睫 (cy188) fits as well.
issues.action: Replaced with a split-second danger: a train approaching a puppy stuck on the tracks.

issues.problem: Context '作者把乡村老师写得栩栩如生' could take 绘声绘色 (cy396) just as well.
issues.action: Rewritten as '小说里的乡村老师形象栩栩如生', a slot 绘声绘色 does not fill.

issues.problem: Context '这次涨价对富人来说是九牛一毛' did not name the huge whole, so 微不足道 (cy199) fits as well.
issues.action: Rewritten to compare the rise of a few yuan with the rich person's wealth.
